title: game/underground.json
description: The underground (B11): the rock layers and their blobs, the bedrock floor, the caves with their entrances, the lava and the ores. Loaded by UndergroundData (Vocaterra.Game.Core); UndergroundValidator checks the values (block names the game has, a dither in order, bands that peak inside their range, a water margin no larger than the entrances' water reach).

generated_by.description: Who or what wrote the file (hand-authored).

strata.description: The rock layers: stone down to ditherToY, deep rock below ditherFromY, a dithered change between, blobs of other rock in the stone.

ditherFromY.description: The y below which the rock is always deep; the dither starts here.

ditherToY.description: The y from which the rock is always stone; the dither ends here.

blobLattice.description: The spacing, in blocks, the blob noise is sampled at and interpolated from.

blobs.description: Patches of other rock in the stone layer; the first row whose noise passes its threshold wins.

cell.description: The noise's first octave's cell across, in blocks.

cellY.description: The noise's first octave's cell up, in blocks.

threshold.description: The noise value, in thousandths, above which the blob is: higher is rarer.

floor.description: The unbreakable floor: a ragged layer from bottomY up.

caves.description: Cheese caverns and spaghetti tunnels on a coarse lattice, and the rules that keep them clear of the ground, the water and the valley.

latticeXz.description: The lattice spacing across, in blocks.

latticeY.description: The lattice spacing up, in blocks.

topY.description: The highest y a cave reaches.

surfaceCover.description: The blocks of rock kept between a cave's top and the ground (an entrance cuts through it).

cheese.description: The caverns: one noise above a threshold that rises with height, so they lie deep.

deepThreshold.description: The threshold, in thousandths, at and below deepY.

shallowThreshold.description: The threshold at and above shallowY (not below the deep one; 1000: none).

spaghetti.description: The tunnels: two noises both within thickness of zero.

thickness.description: How far from zero, in thousandths, each noise may be: the tunnel's width.

underRegionCeiling.description: The highest y a cave reaches under an authored region (its own chunks start at 0); -1 lets the caves meet the valley's own.

waterMargin.description: Blocks round a water cell that stay solid.

bedClearance.description: Blocks under the bed of a water column that stay solid (not below waterMargin).

entrances.description: Where a tunnel opens to the sky: zones of a 2D mask, opened only on dry procedural land over a cave.

cell.description: The mask noise's first octave's cell, in blocks.

threshold.description: The mask value, in thousandths, above which a column is in a zone.

minHeightAboveSea.description: How far over the sea the ground must be.

waterReach.description: Columns round an entrance that hold no water (not below the caves' waterMargin).

probeDepth.description: How far under a cave's top the shaft looks for cave air.

lava.description: Cave air at or below level is lava.

level.description: The highest y that holds lava.

valley.description: B13: how far the underground reaches into the valley's own stone. Every distance is in blocks and measured as a cube (the largest of the three axes).

surfaceDistance.description: How far a changed block stays from any air cell of the valley.

waterDistance.description: How far a changed block stays from any water cell (not under surfaceDistance).

borderMargin.description: Columns in from the valley's edge where nothing changes.

siteMargin.description: How far a changed block stays from a site's level ground, a named point, an NPC or the spawn.

pathMargin.description: How far a changed block stays from a trodden path.

propMargin.description: How far a changed block stays from a block of a prop.

villageSite.description: The site the village stands round (a site of the scene).

villageMargin.description: How far a changed block stays from the village's footprint (the site's level ground and blend).

passPaths.description: The paths of the pass (names of paths of the scene).

passProps.description: The props of the pass (names of props of the scene), the rockfall.

passMargin.description: How far a changed block stays from the pass's paths and props.

id.description: The row's id (lowercase kebab-case): also the key of its random draws.

replaces.description: The rocks its veins may replace; no other block is ever replaced.

min.description: The fewest blocks a vein tries to hold.

max.description: The most blocks a vein tries to hold.

minY.description: The lowest y of the band.

maxY.description: The highest y of the band.

peakY.description: The y the triangular spread of vein centres peaks at (inside the band).

veins.description: Veins tried in a chunk column (16 x 16 blocks, every layer).

blockName.description: A block's name (lowercase, words joined by a hyphen) as BlockDefinition has it.
